AccessRuleResult.description: Result of evaluating a single qualified access rule entry.

comparisons.description: Machine-readable comparisons evaluated by the rule.

modernizedFrom.description:
Deprecated-to-current concept substitutions that processing applied to the data before this rule was evaluated.

Present only when the data carried a deprecated concept. It completes the explanation of the decision: the marking the document bears, the current concept it resolved to, and the comparison this rule actually made. A consumer showing why access was granted or denied should surface it, so the verdict is never reported against a concept the reader never saw.

name.description: Rule name from the access policy (for display).

reason.description: Denial reason from the rule definition or generated explanation.

rule.description: Qualified rule identity and semantic digest.

ruleIndex.description: Zero-based index of the rule in the access policy's evaluated rules.

skipped.description: Whether the rule was skipped because its activation did not match.

ArtifactKind.description: Closed artifact families participating in a composed operation.

ArtifactReference.description: Identifies an immutable artifact participating in a composed operation.

digest.description: Content digest when the resolver can supply one.

AssertionReference.description: Compact reference to an assertion without engine-production metadata.

Attribution.description:
Provenance attached to every source so downstream consumers can render proper attribution and license notices.

Mandatory because most source data we'll integrate (NIST, ICS, IANA, external taxonomies) requires citation. Sources that don't have a formal license should set `license: 'unspecified'` rather than omit it.

citation.description: Suggested citation string for academic / regulatory use.

license.description: SPDX identifier or short license token (e.g. "CC-BY-4.0", "public-domain").

licenseUrl.description: Canonical URL where the license terms can be inspected.

name.description: Display name of the upstream source (e.g. "NIST CSWP-29").

BestEffortRuleSourceReference.description: Best-effort external source join carried by a qualified rule reference.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

reproducibility.description: Whether the source observation can be reproduced byte-for-byte.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identity is forbidden when reproducibility is not proven.

BestEffortSourceReference.description: Best-effort source identity and mandatory attribution for an operation.

attribution.description: Attribution and license information for the observed source.

locator.description: Location from which the mutable content was observed.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

reproducibility.description: Whether the source observation can be reproduced byte-for-byte.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identity is forbidden when reproducibility is not proven.

One deprecated-to-current concept substitution that processing applied before an access rule was evaluated.

The id fields are machine keys; the `*Display` companions carry the rendered marking view, following the same split as `missing` / `missingDisplay`.

conceptId.description: Current concept the access rule was evaluated against.

replacedConceptId.description: Deprecated concept the data was actually marked with.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

reproducibility.description: Whether the source observation can be reproduced byte-for-byte.

attribution.description: Attribution and license information for the observed source.

locator.description: Location from which the content was observed.

providerId.description: Stable identifier for the source provider.

RuleReference.description: Identifies the exact resolved semantics of one policy rule.

ruleDigest.description: RFC 8785/SHA-256 digest of the canonical resolved rule content.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier within the owning artifact.

source.description: External source identity when the rule was not supplied inline.

RuleSourceReference.description: Compact source join carried by a qualified rule reference.

SourceReference.description: Records source identity and mandatory attribution for an operation.

Warning.description:
A non-blocking informational signal surfaced in a result's `warnings`.

Unlike `ValidationError`, warnings never affect `valid`. `kind: 'deprecation'` fires when a deprecated concept is asserted, and `replacement` names a suggested successor concept. `kind: 'rule'` fires when a scheme's authored `warn` rule matches the marking, with the rule's id as `ruleId`. `kind: 'notice'` is the engine speaking about the operation itself rather than about anything the scheme declares; its `ruleId`, when present, is an engine-reserved id beginning with `_`, the same convention a `ValidationError` follows.

A marking's warnings come in a fixed order: deprecations first, then the scheme's rule warnings in the order the scheme declares its rules, then the engine's notices. An aggregate's warnings are about the rolled-up marking, not about each marking that fed it.

categoryId.description: Category this warning relates to (when applicable)

conceptId.description: Concept this warning relates to (when applicable). A rule warning names one when the rule's `when` names exactly one concept the marking holds.

conceptName.description: Resolved operational display for `conceptId` (the concept's rendered marking view), for a consumer that shows the warning next to the concept. `conceptId` stays as the machine key; this is the human-visible string.

kind.description: Warning kind: 'deprecation' for a deprecated concept, 'rule' for a scheme's authored `warn` rule, 'notice' for the engine's own notice.

replacement.description: When kind=deprecation, the suggested replacement concept id (if any)

replacementName.description: When kind=deprecation, the resolved operational display for `replacement` (the successor concept's rendered marking view). `replacement` stays as the machine key; this is the human-visible string.

ruleId.description: The scheme rule that gave a `rule` warning, or the engine-reserved id of a `notice`. Absent on a deprecation warning.

WarningKind.description: Non-blocking warning category: a deprecated concept, a scheme's authored `warn` rule, or a notice the engine gives about the operation itself.

description:
Overall access decision with per-rule breakdown.

Returned by `AccessEngineAdapter.check()`. `granted` is `true` only when every non-skipped rule granted access. Inspect `rules` to surface per-category denial reasons in an authorization UI: each `AccessRuleResult` carries a human-readable `reason` field.

granted.description: True when every rule that was not skipped granted access.

provenance.description:
Source provenance for the access-rule source that evaluated this decision.

Populated only when the `AccessEngine` was wired with an external `AccessRuleSource` override at load time (typically a `MappedAccessRuleSource` the server's Context loader built from an access YAML's `rules.external` block). Inline-backed decisions leave this field undefined to keep payloads compact for the common single-source case.

Identity fields mirror the source's `sourceIdentity()` observation at engine-construction time.

rules.description: One result per rule in the policy, in policy order.

warnings.description: Warnings from preparing and evaluating the target, including automatic changes. Present on granted and denied decisions; empty when none apply.
